current_date: April 2025 (stated on the cover of all three guides: householder, full and major, miscellaneous); files uploaded 05 September 2025 as 'Adopted validation list'
current_evidence: The council's 'Apply for permission' page (last updated 11 June 2026) lists three 'Adopted validation list' DOCX files, all uploaded 05 September 2025: householder (/media/325jhu1k/validation-list-householder-2025-1.docx), full and major (/media/uvofnrse/validation-list-full-and-major-2025.docx) and miscellaneous (/media/cw3m1dzz/validation-list-miscellaneous-2025-1.docx).

issues.detail: The workbook link is the general 'Apply for permission' landing page, not the list. The page resolves, but the URL lacks 'and' (the live page is /planning-and-building-control/...). The actual lists are three adopted DOCX files split by application type. The files the user uploaded match the three linked from that page (validation-list-householder-2025-1.docx, validation-list-full-and-major-2025.docx, validation-list-miscellaneous-2025-1.docx).
issues.evidence: Page: 'Adopted validation list - householder applications / full and major / miscellaneous applications (DOCX) Uploaded 05 September 2025'

issues.detail: Grokbot captured 0 requirements and marked the council 'Link only (not readable: blocked/404/login)'. The three adopted April 2025 guides are ordinary public DOCX files. Their 'Local Validation Requirements' tables hold 99 rows, about 55 distinct requirements, across 12 application types: householder 6 (+1 for larger-extension prior approval), full minor 23, major 39, demolition in a conservation area 6, outline 3, advertisement 4, listed building consent 5, reserved matters 1, s73 4, discharge of conditions 3, tree works 2, Article 4 householder 2. Status, Extraction level and Req. items (0) are all wrong.
issues.evidence: Workbook: Req. items 0; Status 'Link only'. Document: 'Local Validation Requirements' tables in all three guides

issues.detail: The list date (and date basis) is blank. All three guides are dated 'April 2025' on their covers, and the council uploaded them on 05 September 2025 as its 'Adopted validation list'. The list date should be April 2025, with the document cover as the date basis. 'Outdated (>2y)?' should then read No.
issues.evidence: 'Validation Requirements for Planning Applications - Householder Guide / April 2025' (same date on Full and Major and Miscellaneous guides)

issues.detail: The 'Planning page' field points to planning.data.gov.uk (entity 20002), not the council's own planning page, and the URL source is a third-party directory (planninggeek). The search also turned up older 2024 draft and superseded 2025 DOCX versions under /media/, so a re-run should take the files linked from the live page.
issues.evidence: Search results: draft-2024-validation-list-*.docx, validation-list-*-2025.docx (multiple media IDs)

issues.detail: All 18 application-type rows say '(none)' / 'Not covered: local list link found but not readable'. The guides set requirements for 12 of these sheets. Examples: Householder (Hard standing, Heritage Statement, Structural Survey); Full planning (23 local items for minor, 39 for major); Outline (Additional Plans, Details and Plans); Reserved matters (Planning Statement); Listed building consent (Heritage Statement, Ecology, Structural Survey, Photographs); Advertisement consent (Lighting Impact Assessment, town-centre Photomontages, Planning Statement); Lawful development cert (Evidence, Planning Statement); s73 (Plans, Planning Statement, Block Plan); Discharge of conditions (Plans, Samples); Non-material amendment (plans of approved scheme and amendment); Works to trees (Photographs, Structural Report); Demolition in cons area (Tree Survey, Heritage Statement, Ecology, Structural Survey, Viability Report). The Full planning sheet must also separate the minor list (1-9 dwellings, under 1,000 sq m or 1 ha) from the major list, because items such as Affordable Housing Statement, Transport Assessment and Health Impact Assessment apply only to majors.
issues.evidence: Miscellaneous Guide contents: 'Page 17. Application for Outline Planning Permission ... Page 61. Application for Tree Works ...'

issues.detail: On the remaining sheets the 'Not covered' outcome is roughly right but the stated reason is wrong. Change of use - prior approval: the guides say prior notifications follow the GPDO and are not listed. Minerals & waste and County own devt (Reg 3) are Nottinghamshire County Council matters. Hazardous substances, S106 modification and Permission in principle are not in any of the three guides. The guides also cover four application types with no Grokbot sheet: householder prior approval for larger extensions, Hedgerow Removal Notice, Certificate of Lawfulness of Proposed Works to a Listed Building, and householder applications needed because of an Article 4 Direction in a conservation area.
issues.evidence: 'this guide does not specify requirements for 'Prior Notifications' ... These are as prescribed by that legislation.'

issues.detail: Several council-specific items sit in the guides' 'National Validation Requirements' tables, so an extractor that reads only the 'Local' tables will miss them. They are Roof Plans, Demolition Statement, the Levels/Sections item (Major, Outline, LBC and RM tables), LBC 'Material Plans', the Major guide's 'Existing and Proposed Plans - Listed Building Applications', and LDC 'Evidence' and 'Planning Statement'. The Full and Major size bands are also loosely worded ('between 1 and 9 residential units' v. 'residential units of over 10'), which leaves exactly 10 dwellings in neither band.
issues.evidence: '(Development greater than 1000 sq meters or more than 1 hectare and residential units of over 10)'

issues.detail: Coal Mining Risk Assessment is missing. Trigger: sites within Coal Mining referral areas (Full minor and Major local lists). A Coal Mining Report alone is not enough; the assessment must be based on its findings. This matters a great deal in Ashfield's former coalfield.
issues.evidence: 'Coal Mining Risk Assessment | Sites within Coal Mining referral areas.'

issues.detail: Flood Risk Assessment is missing. Trigger: all development of 1 ha or more in Flood Zone 1, development in a critical (drainage) area, and all development in Flood Zones 2 and 3 (Householder, Full minor and Major local lists).
issues.evidence: 'All development of 1 hectare or more in Flood Zone 1, development in a critical area, all development in Flood Zones 2 and 3'

issues.detail: Heritage Statement is missing. Trigger: applications affecting a listed building, conservation area or locally listed building, including the setting of these assets (non-designated assets are judged against the council's 'Criteria for Local Heritage Assets'). It is in the Householder, Full, Major, Demolition in CA and LBC local lists, and is required for all Certificates of Lawfulness of Proposed Works to a Listed Building. In the Article 4 checklist it is required for a building or enclosure in the grounds of a listed building, in a conservation area, or affecting the setting of a listed building, scheduled monument or non-designated heritage asset, and for excavations in an Archaeological Constraint area.
issues.evidence: 'Heritage Statement | Applications affecting a listed building, conservation area, or locally listed building, including the setting of these heritage assets.'

issues.detail: Ecology / Protected Species Surveys and Report is missing. Trigger: development that could affect species protected under the Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981, the Habitats Regulations 2010 or the Protection of Badgers Act 1992, or s41 NERC Act habitats and species. It is in the Full, Major, Demolition in CA and LBC local lists.
issues.evidence: 'Ecology / Protected Species Surveys and Report | Developments that have the potential to affect: ...'

issues.detail: Tree Survey and/or Arboricultural Impact Assessment is missing. Trigger: any proposal where trees on or next to the site could be affected (Householder, Full and Major local lists; 'Tree Survey' for Demolition in CA). It needs an arboricultural specialist and root protection zones on a scaled plan.
issues.evidence: 'Any proposal where there are trees at or adjoining the site that could be affected by the proposed development.'

issues.detail: Contaminated Land Assessment is missing. Trigger: any proposal that redevelops or significantly changes the use of land that could be contaminated by current or historic uses (Full and Major). A Phase 1 report is required, plus Phase 2 and a remediation strategy where Phase 1 recommends them, and a verification report.
issues.evidence: 'You must submit a Phase 1 contaminated land assessment.'

issues.detail: Affordable Housing Statement is missing. Trigger: all major residential developments. It must give the private/affordable mix, tenure and bedroom numbers, and show the affordable units on the floor plans.
issues.evidence: 'Affordable Housing Statement | All major residential developments'

issues.detail: Drainage Strategy is missing. Trigger: major applications. It must cover SuDS implementation, maintenance, management and adoption arrangements, or show that SuDS are not feasible and how drainage will be handled, including during construction.
issues.evidence: 'Drainage Strategy | Major applications.'

issues.detail: Transport Assessment is missing. Trigger: all major development. Further guidance comes from Nottinghamshire County Council highways officers.
issues.evidence: 'Transport Assessment | All major development.'

issues.detail: Travel Plan is missing. Trigger: all major development. It must name a travel plan coordinator and cover management and marketing (Nottinghamshire CC guidance).
issues.evidence: 'Travel Plan | All major development.'

issues.detail: Health Impact Assessment is missing. Trigger: all major applications. It must assess health and wellbeing impacts on communities in and next to the development, with actions for vulnerable groups.
issues.evidence: 'Health Impact Assessment | All major applications'

issues.detail: Parking Plan is missing. Householder 'Parking Plan and Access Arrangements' trigger: where there is an impact on parking or highways/access. Full and Major trigger: all applications that increase the quantum of development and/or alter on-site parking. It covers spaces, servicing and turning, cycle and powered two-wheeler parking, and EV charging points (EV charging is Full/Major only).
issues.evidence: 'Parking Plan | All applications which increase the quantum of development and/or alter the amount of on-site parking.'

issues.detail: Hardstanding is missing. Trigger: all applications where new hardstanding is proposed (Householder, Full and Major). The applicant must confirm the surface is permeable or show how water drains within the site.
issues.evidence: 'Hard standing | All applications where new hardstanding is proposed.'

issues.detail: Structural Survey is missing. Triggers: change of use or conversion of rural/agricultural buildings; listed building works involving demolition or affecting structural integrity; other conservation area proposals that may include substantial demolition (not in the householder version); and felling of a protected tree because of its impact on buildings. It is in the Householder, Full, Major, Demolition in CA and LBC local lists. Article 4 checklist: required where a building or structure is demolished on structural grounds.
issues.evidence: 'Structural Survey | Any applications that involve: - The change of use or conversation of rural/agricultural buildings ...'

issues.detail: Air Quality Assessment is missing. Trigger: any proposal that could have a significant impact on air quality, directly or indirectly (Full and Major).
issues.evidence: 'Air Quality Assessment | Any proposal that could have a significant impact on air quality, either directly or indirectly.'

issues.detail: Bin Stores / Recycling Facilities plan is missing. Trigger: all new development that needs new bin or recycling storage (Full and Major). It needs a scaled plan with elevations, metric dimensions and collection arrangements.
issues.evidence: 'Bin Stores / Recycling Facilities | All new development which would result in the need for new or storage or recycling facilities.'

issues.detail: Floor Space / Accommodation Schedule is missing. Trigger: applications for residential use (Full and Major). It gives unit types, bedspaces, bedrooms and gross internal area in sq m.
issues.evidence: 'Floor Space/ Accommodation Schedule | Applications for residential use.'

issues.detail: Landscaping Scheme is missing. Trigger: applications that include external space (Full and Major). It covers planting, materials, levels and long-term maintenance.
issues.evidence: 'Landscaping Scheme | Applications that include external space.'

issues.detail: Legal Documentation is missing. Trigger: BNG self-build exemption applications (Full and Major). It requires a letter agreeing to a legal agreement or unilateral undertaking to occupy the home as the sole or main dwelling for 3 years, the title deeds, and the solicitor's name and address.
issues.evidence: 'Legal Documentation | BNG Self Build Exemption Applications.'

issues.detail: Self Build Statement is missing. Trigger: self-build applications (Full and Major). It must show why the scheme counts as self-build under the 2015 Act.
issues.evidence: 'Self Build Statement | Self Build applications'

issues.detail: Levels, Existing and Proposed Site Sections and Finished Floor Levels is missing. Trigger: a significant change in levels across the site or street scene, or where more construction detail is needed. It is in the Full local list and also appears in the Major, Outline, LBC and Reserved Matters tables.
issues.evidence: 'All applications where there is a significant change in levels across the site or street scene ...'

issues.detail: Lighting Impact Assessment is missing. Trigger: installation of floodlighting or other external lighting that could affect existing light-sensitive uses (Full, Major and Advertisement consent).
issues.evidence: 'Any proposal which involves the installation of flood lighting or other external lighting and that lighting has the potential to impact on existing light sensitive uses.'

issues.detail: Marketing Information is missing. Trigger: any development that results in the loss of employment space (Full and Major). It needs marketing evidence plus a feasibility study and financial appraisal showing employment use is not viable.
issues.evidence: 'Marketing Information | Any development that results in the loss of employment space.'

issues.detail: Material Details & Materials Plan is missing. Trigger: all applications that propose new buildings (Full and Major). It needs the manufacturer's specification, photographs and RAL colour numbers, plus a Materials Plan where several dwellings use a mixed palette.
issues.evidence: 'Material Details & Materials Plan | All applications where new buildings are proposed'

issues.detail: Noise Impact Assessment is missing. Trigger: development close to existing noise sources, or proposals that could generate significant noise (Full and Major). It must be prepared by a qualified acoustician.
issues.evidence: 'Noise Impact Assessment | Where developments are close to existing sources of noise, or the proposal could generate significant noise levels.'

issues.detail: Open Space Assessment is missing. Trigger: any loss of open space, including playing fields (Full and Major).
issues.evidence: 'Open Space Assessment | All applications where there would be a loss of open space, including playing fields.'

issues.detail: Renewable Energy Statement is missing. Trigger: applications for renewable energy production (Full and Major).
issues.evidence: 'Renewable Energy Statement | Applications for renewable energy production.'

issues.detail: Ventilation/Extraction Statement and Design is missing. Trigger: retail, business, industrial, leisure or other development that proposes ventilation or extraction equipment (Full and Major). It covers odour mitigation, noise levels and a maintenance schedule.
issues.evidence: 'For any retail, business, industrial, leisure or other developments where ventilation or extraction equipment is proposed.'

issues.detail: Archaeological Assessment is missing. Trigger: any proposal that disturbs previously undisturbed ground where archaeological remains are believed to exist (Major). It needs a desk-based assessment, plus a geophysical survey where necessary.
issues.evidence: 'Archaeological Assessment | Any proposal which involves disturbance of previously undisturbed ground where archaeological artefacts are believed to remain.'

issues.detail: Building for a Healthy Life Assessment is missing. Trigger: all major residential applications, ideally within the Design and Access Statement.
issues.evidence: 'Building for a Healthy Life Assessment | All major residential applications.'

issues.detail: Environmental Impact Assessment / Environmental Statement is missing. Trigger: Schedule 1 or Schedule 2 development under the EIA Regulations 2017 (Major). A screening opinion is advised where the development area is over 0.5 ha.
issues.evidence: 'You should request a screening opinion before submitting a planning application if the development area is over 0.5ha'

issues.detail: Glint/Glare Assessment is missing. Trigger: major solar photovoltaic development.
issues.evidence: 'Glint/Glare Assessment | Major development for solar (photovoltaic) panels.'

issues.detail: Heads of Terms (S106 Agreements) is missing. Trigger: all major applications. It needs a letter agreeing the Heads of Terms, up-to-date title deeds and the solicitor's details.
issues.evidence: 'Heads of Terms (S106 Agreements) | All major applications'

issues.detail: Planning Statement is missing for every application type that requires one. Triggers: all major developments; all advertisement applications (justifying the design and location of the advert); all reserved matters applications (how the details relate to the reserved matters); all s73 applications (explaining and justifying the removal or variation); and all LDC applications, existing and proposed (background, compliance with the Local Plan, when the use started, opening times, parking).
issues.evidence: 'Planning Statement | All | A planning statement justifying the design and location of the advert.'

issues.detail: Retail Impact Assessment is missing. Trigger: retail and leisure development outside town centres that does not accord with an up-to-date plan and is over the relevant thresholds (Major).
issues.evidence: 'Applications for retail and leisure development outside town centres, which are not in accordance with an up-to-date plan if over the relevant thresholds'

issues.detail: Site Waste Management Plan is missing. Trigger: all residential development and other applications that affect waste generation (Major). It covers bin storage, waste vehicle tracking and collection; hot food takeaways also need a litter management plan.
issues.evidence: 'Site Waste Management Plan | All residential development and other applications that have an impact on the generation of waste.'

issues.detail: Statement of Community Involvement is missing (Major). Triggers: wind energy with more than two turbines or a hub height over 15 m; alternative uses on allocated employment sites; loss of open space or development on allotment land; leisure and visitor facilities; and loss of existing community facilities such as a pub, church or community centre.
issues.evidence: 'a) The development involves the installation of more than two turbines b) The hub height of any turbine exceeds 15 metres ...'

issues.detail: Utilities Assessment is missing. Trigger: all major developments. It needs details of utility consultation, service locations and easements.
issues.evidence: 'Utilities Assessment | All major developments'

issues.detail: Viability Assessment is missing. Major trigger: any major development that does not offer planning obligations in line with the council's Housing SPD. Demolition in CA ('Viability Report') trigger: demolition proposed because of the cost of repair.
issues.evidence: 'Any major development that does not offer planning obligations in accordance with the council's Housing Supplementary Planning Document (SPD).'

issues.detail: Visual Impact Assessment is missing. Trigger: any application with a potential significant visual impact (Major). It should follow the GLVIA3 methodology.
issues.evidence: 'Visual Impact Assessment | Any application which has a potential significant impact from the visual effects from the proposed development.'

issues.detail: Demolition Statement is missing. Trigger: any application that demolishes a structure or outbuilding over 50 m3 (Demolition in CA and Outline tables). It is a method statement covering risk assessment, asbestos removal and accident prevention.
issues.evidence: 'Demolition Statement | Any application where a structure/outbuilding is over 50m3 is proposed for demolition'

issues.detail: Roof Plans are missing. Trigger: roof extensions, roof terraces, dormer windows, and window and door replacement (Householder, Full, Major and LBC tables). They need whole-property elevations and roof sections, and for terraces the nearest neighbouring windows and privacy screens.
issues.evidence: 'Roof Plans | Roof extensions, roof terraces, dormer windows and window and door replacement.'

issues.detail: Listed building detail plans are missing. LBC 'Material Plans' (all LBC applications) must show all new doors, windows, shopfronts, panelling, fireplaces, plaster moulding and other decorative details to a recognised metric scale. The Major guide repeats this as 'Existing and Proposed Plans' for listed building applications, adding cill and lintel details.
issues.evidence: 'Material Plans | All | Plans to show all new doors, windows, shop fronts, panelling, fireplaces, plaster moulding ...'

issues.detail: Photographs for retrospective applications are missing. Triggers: all retrospective advertisement applications (signage in situ) and retrospective LBC applications (works carried out).
issues.evidence: 'Photographs | All retrospective applications | Photographs of the signage in situ.'

issues.detail: Photomontages are missing. Trigger: advertisement applications within the Town Centre Boundaries defined by the Ashfield Local Plan.
issues.evidence: 'Photomontages | Applications that are within the Town Centre Boundaries'

issues.detail: Details of pre-application discussion are missing. They are listed without a trigger for Demolition in CA (with the LPA and/or Historic England), Outline (with the LPA) and LBC (with the LPA and/or Historic England).
issues.evidence: 'Details of any pre-application discussion with the Local Planning Authority and/or Historic England'

issues.detail: The outline local requirements are missing. 'Additional Plans' (all outline applications) show use, amount, scale parameters, access points and a landscape plan with metric dimensions. 'Details and Plans' are required for every matter to be considered, applying the Full/Major guide's requirements.
issues.evidence: 'Details and Plans | For all matters which are to be considered. | See validation requirements outlined in the ... Full/Major Applications Guide.'

issues.detail: The s73 (removal or variation of condition) local requirements are missing: Plans (all; 1:50/1:100 with metric dimensions), Block Plan (all; 1:500 or 1:200), and Additional Information (where applicable). The Planning Statement for s73 is covered in the Planning Statement issue.
issues.evidence: 'Plans | All | Details to be submitted to support the proposed removal / variation of condition(s)'

issues.detail: The discharge of conditions local requirements are missing: Plans (all), Samples of proposed materials (where applicable; annotated photographs or supplier specifications are accepted), and Additional Information (where applicable).
issues.evidence: 'Samples | Where applicable | A sample of the proposed materials.'

issues.detail: The tree works (TPO and conservation area notification) local requirements are missing. Photographs (all applications) must be edited to show the tree shape after the works, with metric measurements. A Structural Report by a suitably qualified person is required where trees are alleged to be causing structural damage. The national list also needs a Tree Report from an independent arboriculturist when felling is proposed.
issues.evidence: 'Structural Report | Circumstances where it is alleged that Trees are causing structural damage to property.'

issues.detail: The Article 4 Direction (conservation area) householder checklist is missing. No fee is payable where permission is needed only because of the Article 4 Direction. Information depends on the works: photos or elevations plus product details for replacement windows and doors; samples or literature for roof materials; plans and elevations for porches, gates, walls, fences and chimneys; a colour swatch for painting masonry or render; product details for solar PV or thermal equipment. Its local items are a Heritage Statement and a Structural Survey (for demolition on structural grounds).
issues.evidence: 'Article 4 Direction in a Conservation Area ... No Fee - provided the development being applied for is only as a result of the removal of permitted rights by the Article 4 Direction.'

issues.detail: The local requirement for householder prior approval of larger rear extensions (up to 8 m) is missing. Plans (all) must show existing and proposed elevations, site sections, finished floor and site levels, and existing and proposed floor plans at 1:50 or 1:100 with critical dimensions. The source text is cut off mid-sentence.
issues.evidence: 'Local Requirements ... 1 Plans Existing and proposed elevations, site sections and finished floor and site levels, existing and proposed floor plans'

summary: Grokbot recorded no requirements for Ashfield. It linked only the 'Apply for permission' landing page and wrongly marked the lists unreadable, but the three adopted April 2025 guides (householder, full and major, miscellaneous) are public DOCX files with 99 local-requirement rows (about 55 distinct requirements) across 12 application types. As a result every requirement and every application-type sheet is missing, including Ashfield-specific items such as Coal Mining Risk Assessments in referral areas, Health Impact and Building for a Healthy Life assessments for majors, and photomontages for town-centre adverts; a full re-extraction from the three files is needed, reading the 'National' tables as well because several council-specific items are filed there.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
